### Headline summary
- North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion from Binance, moving the majority of the stolen Solana via THORChain. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-hackers-move-81-stolen-solana-route-thorchain?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/north-korea-launches-missiles-toward-the-sea-as-pyongyang-protests-against-us-claims-on-binance-hack/))
- CISA added a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability in WordPress Core to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirming active exploitation. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-confirms-hackers-exploiting.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202394/security/u-s-cisa-adds-wordpress-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog-2.html))
- Hackers altered temperature settings at French blood banks and targeted European supermarket refrigeration systems, highlighting the need for zero trust in OT environments. ([Zscaler Research Blogs](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/product-insights/when-freezers-become-ovens-why-ot-needs-zero-trust-now), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/french-blood-plasma-freezers-hacked/))

### North Korean Hackers Steal $6.34 Billion from Binance
North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion from Binance, moving the majority of the stolen Solana via THORChain, while North Korea conducted missile tests amid protests over the hack. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/binance-hackers-move-81-stolen-solana-route-thorchain?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/north-korea-launches-missiles-toward-the-sea-as-pyongyang-protests-against-us-claims-on-binance-hack/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/fake-interview-software-engineer/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/binance-hack-fake-job-interviews-hackers-steal-billions/))

### CISA flags actively exploited WordPress RCE flaw
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability in WordPress Core to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirming active exploitation. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-confirms-hackers-exploiting.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202394/security/u-s-cisa-adds-wordpress-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog-2.html), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-wordpress-rce-flaw-as-actively-exploited-in-attacks/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-119977-wordpress-core-rce-flaw-exploited-during-software-upgrades/))

### Hackers Target European Refrigeration and Blood Bank Systems
Hackers altered temperature settings at French blood banks and targeted European supermarket refrigeration systems, highlighting the need for zero trust in OT environments and tools to secure exposed controllers. ([Zscaler Research Blogs](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/product-insights/when-freezers-become-ovens-why-ot-needs-zero-trust-now), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/french-blood-plasma-freezers-hacked/), [/r/cybersecurity](https://www.reddit.com/r/cybersecurity/comments/1xnjrj2/tool_to_secure_internetexposed_danfoss_dixell/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/hackers-alter-refrigeration-settings-european-discard-food/))

### APT29 targets unpatched mobile devices via watering holes
The Russia-linked threat actor APT29 is conducting a large-scale campaign using compromised websites and a hijacked web analytics script to deliver n-day exploits to iOS and Android users. ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/apt29-watering-holes-iphones/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/apt29-linked-hackers-hijack-web.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/04/apt29-watering-hole-mobile-devices-n-day-exploits/))

### Malicious cPGuard updates distributed via OpsShield
Attackers compromised the update infrastructure of the cPGuard security suite through OpsShield, distributing malicious updates to thousands of web hosting servers. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/malicious-cpguard-updates-served-in-opsshield-supply-chain-attack/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/04/cpguard-update-supply-chain-compromised/), [News4Hackers](https://www.news4hackers.com/malicious-cpguard-updates-exploit-opsshield-supply-chain-attack/))

### Critical Barracuda Security Flaws Allow Authentication Bypass and Root Access
Multiple reports detail critical vulnerabilities in Barracuda security appliances that allow attackers to bypass authentication and gain root access. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4244334/barracudas-security-appliances-have-a-security-problem-of-their-own.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/critical-barracuda-security-flaws/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/barracuda-email-security-gateway-authentication-bypass-opens-path-to-root/))

### Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirms cyberattack linked to $133M theft
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent transactions, following reports by ZachXBT linking the incident to a $133 million crypto theft. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/zachxbt-french-bank-credit-mutuel-arkea-133m-crypto-theft?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/credit-mutuel-arkea-confirms-cyberattack/), [ZATAZ](https://www.zataz.com/credit-mutuel-arkea-133-millions-de-dollars-detournes/), [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/382486/zachxbt-names-french-bank-credit-mutuel-arkea-as-alleged-victim-of-133m-crypto-theft))

### Chrome 157 update fixes 213 security vulnerabilities
Google released Chrome 157 to the stable channel, addressing 213 security bugs including seven critical flaws related to memory safety and authorization issues. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/chrome-157-rolls-out-with-213-security-fixes-seven-rated-critical/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/google-releases-major-chrome-security-update/), [Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/bugs/2026/11/chrome-157-fixes-213-security-issues-including-7-critical-flaws), [News4Hackers](https://www.news4hackers.com/chrome-157-update-213-security-fixes-7-critical-vulnerabilities-patched/))
